# Séance 0.3.34
A chat no longer tells you it's done while work it started is still going. When Claude hands a job to a subagent, or starts a Codex run such as `sol-implement` in the background, its turn ends straight away, and Séance used to call the chat done right then. It now waits until that work has finished, keeps the light amber meanwhile, and sends one "done" at the end. Codex chats work the same way with their own subagents. "No progress for 15 minutes" also now counts work happening in subagents, background tasks and builds, so a busy chat no longer looks stuck, and the alert says what the chat was waiting on.
A message one chat sends another no longer looks like yours. It shows as a single row in the colour opposite the chat's own: "From" with the sending chat's name and the time. Tap it to read the message, or tap the chat's name to go there. A subagent's report shows the same way, as "Helper report" with its task. A message sent while Claude was busy no longer stays "queued" after Claude has read it.
A chat that another chat opens no longer starts on an account that's at its usage limit. It used to start on your default account every time, and when that account was full, Claude's only reply was "You've hit your weekly limit" while the chat sat there looking finished. Now it starts on your default unless Séance knows that account is full, then on the account of the chat that opened it, then on your other accounts. If Claude still answers with the limit, Séance starts the same chat again on the next account, and the chat's card says so. When every account is full, nothing is opened and the chat that asked is told when each one resets.
Any Claude chat that hits a usage limit now shows as stuck, with the reset time, instead of looking finished.
New Chat on the Mac and phone won't start a chat on an account Séance knows is full; it says when that account resets.
